name: Marquee Bands
description: Two crossing tape bands — accent and ink — wipe on and scroll feature words in opposite directions, alternating filled and outlined type, then wipe off.
move: Two crossing tape bands — accent and ink — wipe on and scroll feature words in opposite directions, alternating filled and outlined type, then wipe off.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Each strip repeats one measured item set four times; its x is speed×time wrapped at one set width, so the scroll is seamless and seekable. Tape wipes are clip-path insets on Flow expo in-out, and the wipe adds a short burst of travel so bands arrive already moving.
adapt: Edit WORDS per band and speeds; band tilt is in the CSS. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Marquee" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
